newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu, money market closes stable.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu, money market closes stable.

text.p: 1305 GMT - The Romanian leu closed flat at 7,200/250 from morning quotes in a market flooded with dollars from foreigners taking part in the local capital market, traders said.
They forecast a slight depreciation starting next week, but dollar supply was seen at high levels, with more hard currency inflows in Romanian equities.

* Operators said the central bank (BNR) was likely to continue its dollar purchases to prevent the leu from firming and to encourage exports. The BNR's bid was 7,220 lei to the dollar, unchanged from the previous two days, traders said.

* The money market stayed cash heavy on Thursday with short-term rates hovering at 43 percent. Traders did not forecast major movements on the money market over the weekend in the absence of instruments to drain leu funds in excess.
* Leu-dollar retail prices fell to around 7,300/400 due to a rise in dollar demand from people who swap some of their savings in dollars, operators from the exchanges houses said.
